description: Acquiring Storage Facilities for the Medical Supplies Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Medical Supply Division, which is under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, procures and stores medicines, other medical supplies and pharmaceutical items required for patient care services and distributes to health institutions. The current storage facilities available at the Medical Supplies Division are only sufficient to store stocks for approximately 22 to 30 days of the total annual medical consumption. However, since it is currently planned to minimize the shortage of medicines by obtaining supplies for more than 06 months of all supplies in the next few months by placing orders on time and maintaining a buffer stock for a period of 03 months, there is a strong need to increase the storage capacity accordingly. As such, the proposal jointly made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to transfer 03 storage buildings, including 02 cold warehouses of 30,000 square feet each and the relevant land in Veyangoda owned by the Food Commissioner's Department, to the Ministry of Health and Mass Media for use for the relevant purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.
